preconditions.description: The input root is either a Node object or None.

postconditions.description: The returned value is either a Node object or None.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else return_value.data == root.data
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the returned value is None. Otherwise, the data of the returned root node matches the data of the input root node.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else return_value.left is None if root.left is None else return_value.left.data == root.left.data
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the returned value is None. Otherwise, the left child of the returned root node is None if the left child of the input root node is None, or the data of the left child of the returned root node matches the data of the left child of the input root node.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else return_value.right is None if root.right is None else return_value.right.data == root.right.data
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the returned value is None. Otherwise, the right child of the returned root node is None if the right child of the input root node is None, or the data of the right child of the returned root node matches the data of the right child of the input root node.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else return_value.random is None if root.random is None else return_value.random.data == root.random.data
postconditions.description: If the input root is None, the returned value is None. Otherwise, the random pointer of the returned root node is None if the random pointer of the input root node is None, or the data of the random pointer of the returned root node matches the data of the random pointer of the input root node.
